notes:
{弁済|べんさい} is a formal term for repayment or settlement of debts and obligations, commonly used in legal and financial contexts.

WRITING:
- {弁|べん} (manage, handle, pay for)
- {済|さい} (settle, finish, pay)

USAGE:
- {弁済|べんさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to repay, to reimburse - suru verb)
- {弁済|べんさい}⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧ (repayment deadline)
- {弁済|べんさい}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ (ability to pay)

LEGAL CONTEXT:
- Used in contract law and civil procedures
- {代位|だいい}{弁済|べんさい} (subrogation payment - third party pays on behalf)
- ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧{弁済|べんさい} (partial repayment)
- ⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧{弁済|べんさい} (full repayment)

COMMON OBJECTS:
- ⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弁済|べんさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to repay a debt)
- ⟦{借入金|かりいれきん}→借入金：29454_kariirekin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弁済|べんさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to repay a loan)
- ⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弁済|べんさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to compensate for damages)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧ - repayment (general, more common)
- {弁済|べんさい} - repayment (formal/legal, broader meaning including fulfilling obligations)
